risks.treatment: Factory bootstrap defaults to dedicated user venv plus check-only mode; system changes require explicit user approval.

risks.risk: cookie/session credentials can grant account access
risks.treatment: Credential-backed channels are opt-in; no secrets in repo; prefer dedicated/secondary accounts; no silent cookie extraction.

risks.risk: upstream tools may expose write operations
risks.treatment: Factory capability is read/search only. Posting/commenting/liking/following/DM/account mutation are denied unless separately mapped and authorized.

risks.risk: prompt injection and misinformation from external content
risks.treatment: All output is untrusted evidence and must pass Factory evidence/provenance gates.

risks.risk: upstream skill attempts global routing ownership
risks.treatment: Do not import its broad MUST USE rule. Factory selective router remains canonical.
Treat command/backend details as VOLATILE_REFERENCE; use doctor/runtime checks and refresh audit before upgrades.

requiredForHostReady: install audited commit on target host
verify at least one zero-config read channel
verify no write capability is exposed by Factory routing
promotionGate.upgradePolicy: Re-audit version/commit before changing the pinned upstream snapshot.
